newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish FLS to acquire German firm.
newsitem.headline: Danish FLS to acquire German firm.

text.p: COPENHAGEN, June 20 (Reuiter) - Danish cement and engineering group FLS Industries said on Friday its F.L. Smidth-Fuller Engineering A/S unit signed a letter of intent to take over leading German weighing and measuring equipment company Pfister GmbH.
It said that Pfister, owned by Germany's Scheugenpflug Holding GmbH, was a world-leading company in the field of weighing and measuring equipment for the cement industry.
It said the deal would take effect retroactively from January 1, 1997. No price was disclosed.
Pfister had a turnover of 52 million marks in 1996, with staff of 150, it said. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
